US visa appointment from Dubai: the official wait is 11.5 months. We get it in 7 working days.

Appointments in Dubai and Abu Dhabi are open right now. Most people never check — they hear "impossible", give up, or book a slot a year out and hope nothing changes.

As of today the US State Department lists the next available B1/B2 interview at 11.5 months in Dubai and 6 months in Abu Dhabi. Both posts are open and taking applications.

We handle the whole file: DS-160 completed, visa fee paid, online account registered, appointment secured, and interview preparation before you go.

No hidden fees. One price, agreed in writing.
